digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow - optionality check
propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml is redundant because its test coverage is already provided by four test matrix cells in _build-and-test.yml with strictly more coverage

Deleting the import-linter job opens a gap where future contributors could inadvertently remove optionality test coverage by adding markers, moving files, or filtering paths without triggering a check failure
A durable collection guard test must replace the deleted job to assert that the two optionality files remain collected under the default suite selection
The guard test must validate actual pytest collection behavior with `-m "not integration and not external"` to catch markers added at file-level, decorator-level, or via conftest
Deletion of the import-linter job is paired with a checked-in test assertion that 9 items collect from the two files under default selection to maintain coverage verification
